id: title:ablaszkiewicz:fix release debug symbol uploads on mac and cross builds

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the PostHog CLI release workflow by configuring linker flags required for generating compatible debug symbols, which are a prerequisite for uploading debug information and potentially resolving native crashes.
review.reason: Adds a conditional RUSTFLAGS environment variable to the GitHub Actions release workflow, P1.F1.H1, setting '-C link-arg=-Wl,--build-id=sha1' for Linux builds. This forces the linker to use SHA1-based GNU build IDs instead of the default. This is a maintenance and compatibility change for the CLI release process.
review.uncertainty: The complete benefit relies on the downstream compatibility of the debug symbol upload step, which is not shown in this chunk. The tier is assigned based on the observable maintenance and compatibility configuration, not on demonstrated incident avoidance or broader systemic improvement.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional RUSTFLAGS environment variable to the GitHub Actions release workflow, setting '-C link-arg=-Wl,--build-id=sha1' for Linux builds. This forces the linker to use SHA1-based GNU build IDs instead of the default (which may be SHA256 or absent depending on toolchain).
observations.posthog_connection: This change affects the PostHog CLI release binaries. The PostHog CLI is a command-line tool distributed to users. Embedding a specific, known GNU build ID is a prerequisite for the subsequent step of uploading debug symbols, which are required for native crash reports to be matched against the CLI's debug symbols.
